outcome.answer: Saahil Mathur and coauthors’ paper is “Retrieval Improvements Do Not Guarantee Better Answers: A Study of RAG for AI Policy QA.” [1] It studies RAG for AI governance and policy analysis using a corpus of AI policy documents, and finds that fine-tuning improves retrieval metrics but does not consistently improve end-to-end QA; stronger retrieval can sometimes produce more confident hallucinations when relevant documents are missing. [1]
